question: Can local supervised weighting reduce the current candidate's near-stable optimism, and at what cost to overall accuracy, unstable-side decisions and farther-stable underestimation? This does not test recovery of missing information.
candidate: Selected16, 42 symmetric physics+xcorr features, MLP32->16 ReLU/L-BFGS, alpha1, four independent-noise training views, seeds42/43/44, unchanged five outer design folds seed42.

arms.unit_control: Explicit sample weights all1, native sklearn weighted fitting path.
arms.local2: Raw weight2 if0<training margin<.05, otherwise1; divide by outer-training mean weight. Apply identical weight to all four views of each physical clip. Sum weights equals training row count, preserving alpha/sum(weights).

controls: Train-only unweighted feature scaling and inactive mask identical across arms. Same initialization, architecture, alpha, optimization caps, acquisition features, folds and seed settings; no hyperparameter search or inner retuning. Native no-weights historical predictions retained as a diagnostic reference because explicit unit weights may alter numerical optimizer trajectories.
evaluation: All11 cached acquisition conditions. Primary clean and fresh iid1% seed932; correlated fresh1% and iid5% seed929 are robustness guardrails. Capture train-design and OOF predictions for every condition; four train-fit exposures per physical clip per seed, one OOF prediction. Average errors/rates, not predictions.
metrics: Whole-dataset mean design MAE; conditional bias and strict over/under exceedance at0/.005/.01/.02/.03/.05 on stable0<m<.01/.02/.05, unstable-.01/-.02/-.05<m<0 and farther-stable m>=.15. Report clip zero-margin wrong-side fractions as descriptive proxies, not event rates. Paired local2-minus-control comparisons use identical physical rows and seed pairing.
uncertainty: 2000 paired whole-design resamples of fixed prediction summaries, seeds averaged within each physical design/clip first. No model-refit uncertainty, multiplicity correction or calibrated safety guarantee. Unseen noise on training designs is in-sample by physical design, not necessarily a seen measurement draw.
scope: 77 training designs /4454 physical clips only. No acquisition regeneration, reserved selection/calibration/test scoring, feature/default replacement, new architecture or penalty sweep. Completed fit shards are atomic and resumable. Keep warnings/convergence failures visible.
